__inputs.name: DS_AZURE_MONITOR
__inputs.label: Existing Azure Monitor datasource
__inputs.description: Select an existing Grafana Azure Monitor connection with access to APPI-AI-PLATFORM-FOUNDRY. No credentials or new authentication configuration are included.

title: TOGG Foundry - Input and Output Tokens
description: Live Application Insights token consumption. Input is Prompt Tokens; Output is Completion Tokens. Preaggregated valueSum is used, not event counts. Reasoning and cached token categories are not added again. Select an existing Azure Monitor datasource during import.

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: All : __all,DeepSeek V4.1 Flash : DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017,Kimi K3.1 Pro : Kimi-K3.1-Pro

list.name: dimension
list.label: Break down by
list.query: Model : Model,Subscription : Subscription ID,API : API ID,Region : Region,Service ID : Service ID,Service name : Service Name,Service type : Service Type

panels.title: Input tokens
panels.description: Prompt Tokens over the selected time range and model.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == 'Prompt Tokens'
| extend Model = tostring(customDimensions['Model'])
| where Model in ('DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017','Kimi-K3.1-Pro')
| where ${model:singlequote} == '__all' or Model == ${model:singlequote}
| summarize InputTokens = sum(coalesce(valueSum, value))

panels.title: Output tokens
panels.description: Completion Tokens, including provider-reported reasoning where applicable. Do not add Reasoning Tokens again.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == 'Completion Tokens'
| extend Model = tostring(customDimensions['Model'])
| where Model in ('DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017','Kimi-K3.1-Pro')
| where ${model:singlequote} == '__all' or Model == ${model:singlequote}
| summarize OutputTokens = sum(coalesce(valueSum, value))

panels.title: Total tokens
panels.description: Total Tokens as reported by the model. Excludes duplicate aggregate OTel metric series.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name == 'Total Tokens'
| extend Model = tostring(customDimensions['Model'])
| where Model in ('DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017','Kimi-K3.1-Pro')
| where ${model:singlequote} == '__all' or Model == ${model:singlequote}
| summarize TotalTokens = sum(coalesce(valueSum, value))

panels.title: Input / Output over time
panels.description: Choose the breakdown dimension above. Uses log dimensions, so Metrics Explorer dimension opt-in is not required.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name in ('Prompt Tokens','Completion Tokens')
| extend Model = tostring(customDimensions['Model'])
| where Model in ('DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017','Kimi-K3.1-Pro')
| where ${model:singlequote} == '__all' or Model == ${model:singlequote}
| extend Dimension = tostring(customDimensions['${dimension:raw}']), Direction = iff(name == 'Prompt Tokens','Input','Output')
| summarize Tokens = sum(coalesce(valueSum, value)) by timestamp = bin(timestamp, $__interval), Series = strcat(Direction, ' / ', Dimension)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Input / Output by selected dimension
panels.description: Exact prompt/completion token sums. The total is Input + Output; reasoning/cache categories are not counted a second time.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name in ('Prompt Tokens','Completion Tokens')
| extend Model = tostring(customDimensions['Model'])
| where Model in ('DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017','Kimi-K3.1-Pro')
| where ${model:singlequote} == '__all' or Model == ${model:singlequote}
| extend Dimension = tostring(customDimensions['${dimension:raw}']), Tokens = coalesce(valueSum, value)
| summarize InputTokens = sumif(Tokens, name == 'Prompt Tokens'), OutputTokens = sumif(Tokens, name == 'Completion Tokens') by Dimension
| extend TotalTokens = InputTokens + OutputTokens
| order by TotalTokens desc
